pattern.title: Bead pattern maker
pattern.subtitle: Upload pixel art — one art pixel becomes one bead. Match to MARD, Perler, Hama, Artkal, Nabbi, IKEA Pyssla, and more. Tell us which colours you own and we only use those.
pattern.chartLinkLabel: Browse the MARD colour chart on this site
pattern.stockHint: Uncheck colours you do not have. Enable “Only use my stock” below so the matcher never picks missing shades.
pattern.stockHintMard: Uncheck colours you do not have, or click a series (A, B, … Q, P) to toggle a whole MARD line at once. Enable “Only use my stock” so the matcher skips missing shades.
pattern.stockMardSeriesToggle: {series} — {label}. Click to enable or disable the whole line.
pattern.restrictToStockHint: Nearest-colour matching is limited to checked colours above — useful when you are missing part of a palette.
pattern.stockEmpty: Select at least one colour in your stock, or turn off “Only use my stock”.
pattern.uploadHint: PNG, JPG, WEBP or GIF — ideal for pixel art (e.g. 18×18 sprites)
pattern.examplesHint: Click one of these OMOK pieces to load it instantly.
pattern.oneToOneNote: One art pixel = one bead. If your PNG is upscaled (e.g. 54×54 for an 18×18 sprite), we merge each uniform block automatically.
pattern.pixelBlockHint: Auto detects 2×2, 3×3, 4×4, etc. when each art pixel is a solid block of identical file pixels — then merges them into one bead. Pick a size manually if Auto is wrong.
pattern.pixelBlockNoneDetected: No upscaled blocks detected — using every file pixel

matchMethodHint.lab76: Perceptual colour distance in CIE Lab — good default for bead matching.
matchMethodHint.lab2000: Stricter perceptual formula; can pick different neighbours for subtle shades.
matchMethodHint.rgb: Straight sRGB distance; simple but less accurate to the eye.
matchMethodHint.weightedRgb: RGB with extra weight on green; sometimes closer to how monitors look.

pattern.trimTransparentHint: Trims empty transparent edges before building the grid — useful when sprites have extra canvas space.
pattern.removeBgHint: Treats near-black and transparent pixels as empty peg holes.
pattern.imageScaledNote: Large image — analysed at {analysisWidth}×{analysisHeight} (original {fileWidth}×{fileHeight}) so the page stays responsive.
pattern.canvasPreviewNote: Large pattern — preview uses canvas for performance ({count} beads).
pattern.statsEmpty: No beads yet — upload an image to start.
pattern.privacy: Your image never leaves this device — all matching runs locally in the browser.
pattern.errorLoad: Could not read that image. Try another file.
pattern.emptyPattern: Upload a pixel image to see your bead pattern here.
pattern.editHint: Click a colour in the stats list or grid, then replace it — or merge similar shades to reduce your bead count.
pattern.mergeSimilarHint: Combines palette colours within the ΔE threshold (Lab space). Keeps the most-used colour in each group.
pattern.disclaimer: Colours are matched to digital hex references (ΔE in Lab space). Physical beads may differ — always check against real samples before ordering.
